title: Ember Vigil
tagline: Keep your lantern lit and survive the winter night.
summary: A survival roguelite in a dark Nordic forest. You move, your rune weapons fire by themselves, and dawn is seven minutes away.
about: Monsters pour out of the winter forest and you have one job: keep your lantern burning until dawn. You only steer. Your weapons fire on their own, so every decision is where to stand and which upgrade to take next.

Collect blue crystals to level up and build your own mix of burning bolts, a ring of embers, firepots, Tyr's spear and northern lights that chain between enemies. Max out a weapon, pair it with the right blessing and open a chest to evolve it into something far stronger.

Every run earns embers, even when you fall. Spend them on permanent upgrades and new heroes, then head back out and last a little longer. Survive a night to unlock the next one. There are ten, each harder than the last.

3 bosses, from a fell troll to the Frost Giant

title: Snowfeud
tagline: Penguin artillery. Beat the bot, or duel a friend over a link.

about: Two teams of penguins face each other across the snow with a mountain in the way. Drag back to aim, let go to throw, and read the wind before every shot. Bury the whole enemy team to win.
Play the bot and work your way through three rivals: The Rookie, The Pro and The Legend. Your first match unlocks six special weapons, walking and switching penguins.

tagline: Fly bush planes, airliners and an air ambulance over the real Åland.

about: Take off from Mariehamn and fly over the real Åland: forests, fields, bare rock, lakes and towns from satellite data, terrain from elevation models, and every road, building and lighthouse from OpenStreetMap. The map reaches all the way to Stockholm and Turku.

Choose between five aircraft: a bush plane on wheels, a seaplane on floats, a twin turboprop, an airliner with fly-by-wire and a yellow air ambulance helicopter. Eight missions include medevac flights as far out as Kökar.
New to flying? The first flight walks you through takeoff, turns and landing. A landing guide shows the glide path and the speed to hold, and every touchdown gets up to three stars.

title: ICE FLOE
tagline: Drop, merge and chase the Midnight Sun. A new puzzle every day.
summary: A daily merge puzzle with real physics. Drop ice into the fjord, merge matching pieces and reach the Midnight Sun before it overflows.
about: Drop pieces of ice into the fjord. When two matching pieces touch they merge into the next size up, from a tiny snowflake all the way to the Midnight Sun. The pieces tumble, roll and settle for real, so every drop shifts the whole pile.

Chain merges quickly to build a combo multiplier. Let the ice rest above the dashed line for too long and the run is over. Once you reach the Midnight Sun it stays on the board and keeps glowing, so the fjord fills up faster.
Every day there is a new puzzle with the same pieces for everyone. Share your result and compare with friends, keep your daily streak alive, or play Endless mode for new pieces every round.

In a duel two players share one fjord and take turns dropping. A merge scores for whoever dropped the piece that made it. Thirty pieces each, most points wins, and whoever overflows the fjord loses. Play a friend on the same phone or one of three computer rivals.

title: Cup Clash
tagline: Flick the ball into your rival's cups. Clear the rack first.
summary: Swipe to flick a ping pong ball across the table into ten cups. Sink both throws for the balls back, clear your rival's rack first to win. Play the computer, a friend on one phone, or clear the rack in as few throws as you can.
about: Swipe up to throw: a longer swipe throws farther, and a swipe to the side sends it left or right. Your last throw stays on the table as a faint trail, so you can adjust the next one. Hit the rim and the ball might bounce into the cup next door.

You get two balls a turn. Sink both and you get them back. Cups are re-racked into tighter shapes at six, three and one left. Biscuit throws with feeling, Skeeter has a steady arm and Sniper never misses twice.

Pass and play hands the phone over between turns with a ready screen, so nobody sees the other's swipe. Clear the rack is a solo challenge: sink all ten cups in as few throws as you can and beat your record.

title: Color Claim
tagline: Pick a colour, swallow the board. Own more than half to win.
summary: A quick strategy duel on a grid of colours. Each turn you pick a colour and your land swallows every touching tile of it. Own more than half the board to win, against the computer or a friend face to face.
about: You start in one corner and your rival in the other. On your turn, pick a colour: your whole land turns that colour and grabs every tile of it that touches your border, chain after chain. You can never pick your own colour or your rival's, so every move also decides what they cannot take next.
Own 41 of the 80 tiles and the board is yours. Smudge picks what looks nice, Swatch grabs the biggest bite and Chroma thinks four moves ahead. Beat one to unlock the next.

Face to face puts two players on opposite ends of one phone, each with their own colour buttons. The daily flood is a solo puzzle: fill the whole board from one corner in par or fewer moves, the same board for everyone that day. Every colour also has its own shape, so it works for colourblind players.

title: Axe Spin
tagline: Throw axes into a spinning shield. Beat all six bosses.
summary: Tap to throw. Every axe has to stick in the spinning shield without hitting the ones already there. Thirty stages, six bosses, a daily gauntlet and duels on one shield.
about: A wooden shield spins in front of you and you hold a stack of axes. Tap to throw one. It sticks where it lands, and the next one must not hit it. Use all your axes and the shield bursts apart. Hit an axe and it is over.

Every stage spins its own way: steady, speeding up, braking, swinging back and forth. Some shields come with axes already stuck in them, and apples on the rim pay out coins. Every fifth stage is a boss, from the Old Oak and the Troll Shield to the Giant's Eye, and beating a boss sets your checkpoint and wins you its axe.

The daily gauntlet is eight stages with one life, the same for everyone that day. For two players, take turns on one shield with a friend on the same phone, or take on Sigrid, Bjorn and the Jarl. The first to hit an axe loses.

title: Sea Glass Sort
tagline: Pour the sea glass until every jar holds one colour.
summary: A calm, clever sorting puzzle. Pour glass between jars until each jar is a single colour, in as few moves as you can. Over a hundred levels across five shores, a daily puzzle and duels.
about: Tap a jar, then tap where it should pour. The top pieces move across, but only onto the same colour or into an empty jar, and a jar holds four. Fill every jar with a single colour to finish the level.

Every level has a par worked out by the game itself. Match it for three stars, and keep an eye on your moves: an undo or an extra jar can save you, but the jar caps you at two stars. The levels grow from three colours to twelve as you travel from Driftwood Beach to the Northern Lights. Each colour also has its own small symbol, so the game works for colourblind players too.

The daily puzzle is the same for everyone and easy to share. In a duel both players sort the same jars and the fewest moves wins. Play a friend on one phone or watch Sandy, Marina or the Tide go first and beat their count.

tagline: Aim, fire a volley of balls and break the blocks before they reach the floor.
summary: Every turn you fire all your balls at once. Bank them off the walls, break numbered blocks, grab extra balls and lasers, and stop the wall from reaching the floor.

title: Stack Tower
tagline: One tap, one block. How high can you stack?
summary: Drop each sliding block onto the tower. Whatever hangs over is cut off, so every miss makes the next drop harder. Land it perfectly and the block stays whole.
about: A block slides across the top of your tower. Tap to drop it. The part that lands on the block below stays, the part hanging over the edge breaks off and falls, and the next block is only as big as what is left.

Land a block exactly on the one below for a perfect drop. Each perfect plays the next note of a rising tune, and from the third in a row the block starts growing back, so a long perfect run can save a tower that was getting thin.
The higher you climb, the faster the blocks slide and the sky changes from day to dusk to stars. Beat your best height to unlock new tower styles: Sunset, Candy, Aurora, Glacier and Neon.

In a duel you take turns on the same tower, with a friend on one phone or against the computer. Whatever you trim off makes the block smaller for your opponent, and the first to miss the tower completely loses.
